test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2022 - General Knowledge (Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Under article 100(3) of the Constitution of India, the quorum to constitute a sitting of either House of Parliament is ______ of the total number of Members of the House.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. __one-tenth.__
